implement.name: expect-actual-across-source-sets
implement.summary: An expect declaration lives in commonMain, each actual lives in the platform source set that can resolve it — the contract is one source of truth, the implementations are by target

implement.name: source-set-layout
implement.summary: Source sets are the layout: commonMain holds what every target compiles, androidMain / iosMain / jvmMain hold what only their target does, intermediate source sets hold shared subsets of targets

implement.name: platform-tests-and-dependencies
implement.summary: Platform-specific tests live in the matching test source set, dependencies per target declare the dependency for the targets that need it — a test in androidTest is not a test in commonTest

implement.name: cocoapods-swift-interop
implement.summary: Cocoapods integration is declared once, per pod, with its iOS deployment target and the Swift bridging configuration — no pod reaches the build twice, no Swift consumer wires twice

implement.name: kmp-target-declaration
implement.summary: Targets declare the triples a target family actually ships — iosArm64 / iosX64 / iosSimulatorArm64 for Apple, androidTarget for Android, jvm("…") for desktop — and the list is the one source of truth, not the IDE's view

implement.name: kmp-shaped-gradle-wiring
implement.summary: KMP-shaped Gradle wiring: the kotlin {} block applies the Kotlin Multiplatform plugin, source-set dependencies go through dependencies { "commonMainImplementation"(...) }, convention plugins expose kotlin("…") targets without re-declaring them

review.name: Kotlin Multiplatform Mobile refusals
review.summary: expect/actual in the wrong source set, source-set layout that mixes commonMain with platform code, platform-specific tests in commonTest, undeclared Cocoapods pods, a missing iosArm64 or androidTarget, Gradle wiring that bypasses the Kotlin Multiplatform plugin

find-spec.name: Kotlin Multiplatform Mobile reference
find-spec.summary: The KMP-specific rule set: expect/actual across source sets, the source-set layout, the iOS/Android split, Cocoapods and Swift interop, target declaration, KMP-shaped Gradle wiring
